about: Newsletter sign-ups for event sources (decision P44). The project newsletter inbox (an AgentMail inbox; its address and key are GitHub secrets, never in this repository) is signed up with scripts/newsletter-signup.ts. Issues are read by ingest/adapters/agentmail.ts for sources with a newsletterSourceId. Status: confirmed, submitted (waiting for the first email), pending-confirmation, owner-by-hand (a CAPTCHA or robots.txt stops our bot; the owner signs up by hand), needs-personal-info, none-found, failed.
